{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid revenue values
invalid_revenue = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isna()]

# Count number of completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Check if any completed orders have negative or zero revenue (which might indicate issues)
completed_zero_or_negative = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'] <= 0)].shape[0]

# Display results
completed_orders, completed_zero_or_negative, invalid_revenue.shape[0]"}
